response.consequence: A replay with more than one page of segments sends duplicated error log lines to Seer, and in chronological order they are wrong. The generated summaries are therefore inaccurate for multi-page replays.
response.explanation: The endpoint passes the full error_events list to analyze_recording_segments through functools.partial, and paginate calls it once per page of segment metadata. Each call runs gen_request_data with error_idx reset to 0. Every error that is not interleaved before an event in that page is emitted by the trailing loop, so on each page the log includes those errors again. Also, error timestamps come from nodestore in seconds, while replay event timestamps are normally in milliseconds. The comparison `error.timestamp < event.timestamp` is then nearly always true, so errors are placed before the first event instead of in chronological order.
response.title: Error events are re-emitted on every paginated page and compared against ms timestamps
